senses.gloss: (v. מַס II) unto tribute, tributary (used homiletically as an independent word).
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>שרתי</he> (ref. to <he>היתה למס</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">ib.</cite>) <he>לפי שעבדו ישראל ע״ז לפיכך היתה למס היא למס היא סמל</he> because the Israelites worshipped idols (<cite ref="O01102"><he>סֶמֶל</he></cite>), therefore she (Jerusalem) became tributary, the letters of <he>סמל</he> and <he>למס</he> being the same; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">ib.</cite> [read:] <he>הפכה דלמס סמל</he> the inversion of <he>למס</he> is <he>סמל</he>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הוא סיני הוא ל׳ וכ׳</he> the numerical value of <cite ref="O00737"><he>סיני</he></cite> (130) is the same as that of <he>למס</he>.
Ib. ורבנן אמרי למַסָּא דלבא (v. מַס I) but the Rabbis explain lamas, unto melting of the heart (she became faint); v. מַסָּא I.
